beta.notes:
Native Plex client for MiSTer. Built for CRTs at 480i over Component, RGB, S-Video or Composite, with 480p on HDMI.

Beta access. This is a paid early-access build. Install and browsing work without a code. Playback needs the code from the MisterZine Patreon post. Stable releases will be free and codeless.

New in beta.14
- Remove from Continue Watching. A movie's page and an episode's actions now end with Remove from Continue Watching. Your place is kept, and watching it again brings it back.
- Patreon page. The last item in the menu thanks supporters and lists them by name. Beta access has moved there from Options.
- Updates, redone. Options > Updates tells you straight away whether you're up to date, shows the one update to install with its size, keeps going if you leave the screen, and offers Restart now when it's ready. A failed update stays on screen, and is flagged on Home and in Options, until it's sorted out.
- HDMI setting checks. Options now flags MiSTer INI settings that hurt playback over HDMI: forced VRR or FreeSync (reported to make 24 fps films stutter), HDMI at 50 Hz, DVI mode (no sound over HDMI), and a Plex section that a later [MiSTer] section overrides. Each explains exactly which lines to add. It reads the INI MiSTer loaded, alternative INIs included.
- Send a report reads the INI MiSTer actually uses, alternative INIs included.
- Options has a scrollbar, like the library lists.
- The episode action row behaves better: it returns to its start when you go back up to the episodes, and a row that fits no longer shifts when you reach its last action.

Everything from beta.13 is included.

Requirements
- Networked MiSTer on current MiSTer Linux
- 250 MB free on the SD card
- Plex account with a server that can transcode

Install
1. Download the Beta installer below and put it in the SD card's Scripts folder.
2. Run it from Scripts.
3. Follow the sign-in screen at plex.tv/link.

Already on an earlier beta: open Options > Updates in the app and install from there.

NTSC 480i only; PAL isn't supported yet.

This is unstable beta software. It talks to your real Plex account: playback, watched marks and resume points change your library, and a bug could change them wrongly. Use it at your own risk; no responsibility is taken for what it does to your library or your MiSTer.
